public_rationale: Independent release-era testing documented repeated errors and contradictions on a basic motion question. That supports the qualified claim that ChatGPT could not be relied upon for physical reasoning. A separate evaluation found good physical commonsense performance on small samples. Those successes limit the breadth of the conclusion but do not contradict the explicit allowance for correct answers.
limitations: Support concerns demonstrated unreliability, not total inability or a measured failure rate.
The strongest failure evidence is a narrow case study published after the post.
This assessment does not extend to later ChatGPT versions.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Broad, repeatable testing of the same release-era system establishes dependable physical reasoning and shows that the alleged failures were misreported or depended on materially misleading prompts. Isolated successes are insufficient.
